text:
Denis Villeneuve says he was deeply disappointed when ‘AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY’ put its release date on the same day as ‘DUNE: PART 3’.

“Disney put the biggest franchise of all time against us. I'm no fool. Those movies are a mammoth… 

Dune is not a mammoth like the Avengers, but it's a sexy little animal that has a lot of firepower, and I hope we will survive.”

(Source: https://t.co/wDVmbjKoa1)
